ostrzezenia.tekst: NCHFP research found that garlic-in-oil mixtures stored at room temperature are at risk of botulism.
There is no research showing that adding herbs or vegetables to butter makes a product that is safe at room temperature or in the refrigerator.
In a 1993 bulletin, the FDA warned against preparing seasonings in oil, margarine or butter at home for extended storage.
